en.description:
A tiny arcade for your wrist. Watch Minigames packs ten quick, polished games into a standalone Apple Watch app 

MINI GOLF
Putt through built-in holes full of bumpers, boost pads, spinners, and portals. Then open the course editor and build your own — lay out the fairway, drop in obstacles, add islands you can only reach by portal, and save your creations to play any time.

THE ARCADE
• Super Pong — a fast paddle rally against a bot you can tune from easygoing to ruthless
• Bricks — endless brick breaking that rebuilds the wall a little meaner every time you clear it
• Stacker — pile household junk as high as you can before it all comes crashing down
• Fruit Drop — slide the basket and catch everything the tree throws at you
• Echo — four pads sing a pattern; tap it back, with one extra note every round
• 2048 — the classic merge puzzle, right at home on a tiny screen
• Pairs — a calm 4×4 memory board; clear the pairs in as few moves as you can
• Spin — tap the sweeping ball the instant it crosses the gold wedge
• Keep-Ups — kick the ball to keep it airborne as gravity slowly turns against you
en.subtitle: Fun Minigames for Your Watch

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
New games:

• Bricks — endless brick breaking
• Fruit Drop — catch what the tree throws
• Echo — a pattern-memory singalong
• 2048 — the merge classic
• Pairs — a calm memory board
• Spin — nail the sweep before the wedge shrinks
• Keep-Ups — keep the ball off the grass

Also fixed: Digital Crown controls in every game are smoother and slower, with proper haptic feedback.
Bug Fixes, performance fixes, digital crown issues
